mapper.insert: insert into goods_sku (goods_id, spec_value, price, stock, img) values (#{goodsId}, #{specValue}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{img})
mapper.select: select count(distinct goods_id) from goods_sku where stock < #{threshold}
select * from goods_sku where goods_id = #{goodsId} and spec_value = #{specValue} order by id asc
mapper.update: update goods_sku set stock = stock - #{num} where goods_id = #{goodsId} and spec_value = #{specValue} and stock >= #{num}
update goods_sku set stock = stock + #{num} where goods_id = #{goodsId} and spec_value = #{specValue}
update goods_sku set stock = stock + #{num} where id = #{id}
